/--
Prove that $\mathbb{Q}/\mathbb{Z}$ has no proper subgroups of finite index.
-/
theorem eq_top_of_finiteIndex (H : AddSubgroup (ℚ ⧸ (Int.castAddHom ℚ).range)) (h_fin : H.FiniteIndex) :
    H = ⊤ := by
  set G := ℚ ⧸ (Int.castAddHom ℚ).range with hG_def
  set n := H.index with hn_def
  have hn_pos : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h_fin.finiteIndex
  -- Bridge: every n • z lies in H.
  have hfin : Finite (G ⧸ H) := by
    have := h_fin
    infer_instance
  have key : ∀ z : G, n • z ∈ H := by
    intro z
    have hcard : Nat.card (G ⧸ H) = n := by
      rw [hn_def, AddSubgroup.index]
    -- order in the quotient divides Nat.card
    have hzero : (n : ℕ) • (QuotientAddGroup.mk' H z) = 0 := by
      have h1 : addOrderOf (QuotientAddGroup.mk' H z) ∣ Nat.card (G ⧸ H) :=
        addOrderOf_dvd_natCard _
      rw [hcard] at h1
      exact addOrderOf_dvd_iff_nsmul_eq_zero.mp h1
    have : QuotientAddGroup.mk' H (n • z) = 0 := by
      simpa using hzero
    exact (QuotientAddGroup.eq_zero_iff _).mp this
  -- Now show H = ⊤.
  rw [AddSubgroup.eq_top_iff']
  intro x
  -- Find y with n • y = x, using divisibility in ℚ/ℤ.
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective x
  -- y := mk (q / n)
  set y : G := QuotientAddGroup.mk ((q : ℚ) / (n : ℚ)) with hy_def
  have hy : n • y = QuotientAddGroup.mk q := by
    rw [hy_def]
    rw [← QuotientAddGroup.mk_nsmul]
    congr 1
    have hnne : (n : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn_pos.ne'
    field_simp
  rw [← hy]
  exact key y

and let $\{\alpha_1, \dots, \alpha_5\}$ be zeros of $f(x)$ in $K$. Show that if $\mathbb{Q}
(\alpha_1, \alpha_2, \alpha_3) \neq K$, then $\\mathrm{Gal}(K/\mathbb{Q}) \cong S_5$.-/
theorem nonempty_gal_mulEquiv_perm_fin_five {f : ℚ[X]} {K : Type} [Field K] [Algebra ℚ K]
    [IsSplittingField ℚ K f] (hf1 : Irreducible f) (hf2 : f.natDegree = 5) (a₁ a₂ a₃ : K)
    (ha1 : a₁ ∈ rootSet f K ∧ a₂ ∈ rootSet f K ∧ a₃ ∈ rootSet f K)
    (ha2 : a₁ ≠ a₂ ∧ a₂ ≠ a₃ ∧ a₃ ≠ a₁)
    (h : IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ {a₁, a₂, a₃} ≠ ⊤) :
    Nonempty (f.Gal ≃* (Equiv.Perm <| Fin 5)) := by
  sorry
